notes.title: Development Notes | 2021.02.20
notes.content:
Happy Chinese New Year, SAO Players!
Finally, we've finished refactoring all the widgets for the next major version of SAO Utils.
Here's the last pieces of them :P

[h1]PDH Data Extension[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/f589e962fdcff0901624b72cb3addf5ca072df78.png[/img]

Was originally created by RangerCD, has been ported to our new NERvGear platform now:
[list]
[*]The "Integer Value" and "Decimal Value" will be merged into a single data value, you will change the output format via "Value Format" option.
[*][code][0, 10240]\Network Interface(*)\Bytes Received/sec[/code]
Prepending "[MIN,MAX]" prefix for the PDH querying string to specify a custom maximum and minimum value is no longer needed, you will input these values via the "Minimum Value" and "Maximum Value" options.
[/list]

[h1]Mail Box[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/34c0e22cb05e1af74022fa23e8bf8406718ffd80.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]The "Inbox", finally, implemented XD.
[*]New "GGO" dialog and widget style.
[*]New IMAP protocol support, the POP3 support will be deprecated.
[*]Feel free to add or remove the mail icon, the mailing system can be functional without any widgets.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/c8945a51410047d41321e9781d8f643d477ba250.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/67bc2cbba3313ec9a2e197f5544315dfd5a12a6c.png[/img]

[h1]Bangumi Anime Schedule[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/7a5177f6722697355df4b38b71bb468ddcacf55f.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Unlimited widget amount with separated preferences.
[*]Customizable schedule table and playback url.
[*]Customizable widget colors.
[*]New "Display special schedules", "Display late night schedules" and "Display custom schedules only" options.
[*]New "Animate Schedule" data source.
[*]Using JSON format to storage and transfer schedule data, maintaining via [url=https://github.com/NERvGear/bangumi/tree/json]GitHub Pull Request[/url].
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/85c0d945e11865b990049ed25ec0c5b64c2efdd1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/6012af8271bfd27b19a68ae13580272c9c1a250c.png[/img]

[h1]Excelsior Package[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/ae342e1effa18bef9471ae062d31157ee7f570c7.png[/img]

Welcome to [spoiler]Dicky Twister[/spoiler] Night City! We have prepared some cyberpunk elements for you:
[list]
[*]New "CP77" style for "HP-Bar" widget.
[*]More backgrounds available for "HUD Widget"
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/6c101f3f1635fc458378224743b2e95d16de2e87.png[/img]

One more thing. It is likely that we can get started with some closed tests after next development note released, so please stay tuned!

notes.title: Development Notes | 2020.03.13
notes.content:
Hi again, SAO players.
Would you like to see more exciting new features for next major version of SAO Utils?
Here they are :P

[h1]HP-Bar[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/b092c83baa038fd0e8ba012f297a6cce25221ce8.png[/img]

Except for new features already added in Exp version, there will be even more:
[list]
[*]New "ALO" theme.
[*]For ALO theme, the "HP" and "MP" gauges can be bound to different data values.
[*]Each item could have its own icon.
[*]Place unlimited amount of HP-Bar widgets in different themes on desktop.
[/list]

[h1]HUD Widget[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/70e2081134beda9fb798b1b380da1a0b4c9680a6.png[/img]

The "GGO Widget" will be renamed as "HUD Widget" because of some ability changes.
[list]
[*]Customize items' background (Hexagon style and more).
[*]Customize items' unit size (0.5~9).
[*]Customize items' color.
[*]Customize items' layout, including alignments and spacing.
You can arrange multiple non-rectangular items using only one widget now.
[*]New "Image (Data Source)" item view.
This enables you to display different images according to the associated data source, e.g. Album Cover.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=qpWfDbpgWRk;full][/previewyoutube]

With the new widget editing mode, you can modify batch items more easily.

[h1]Action Picker[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/8186871ae749492fd0082b1f72ebaa039baf2b6d.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Unify the browsing and choosing operation for widget and menu actions.
[*]New "Widget Action": control widgets' visibility.
[*]New "Miscellaneous" actions: show, hide launcher and more.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/cab72b805d6a4238f1d088637f4c4080521d16ba.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/786520/partnerevents/view/1816579782926613098]Similar to "Script Value"[/url], you can write JavaScript codes within "Script Action":
[list]
[*]Execute multiple actions at a time.
[*]Program the action execution logic.
[*]Persistence or share data between actions and data sources.
[*]Include "Execute ALL" and "Execute Sequentially" examples.
[/list]

[h1]Background Picker[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/14647ae7a722c35bfea13cd845c294c36c3cdd52.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Background browsing and choosing for widgets such as "HUD Widget".
[*]Support Nine-Patch Image format (*.9.ext).
[/list]

notes.title: Development Notes | 2020.01.03
notes.content:
Hi, SAO players, long time no see!
Today (?) I would like to show you some exciting new features in next major version. Please leave comments to tell us your ideas!

[h1]New Widget Operations[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/625dcd28807116846fe3c5c156f6fc6a39da13e5.png[/img]

[list]
[*]Now we provide a standard frame for every desktop widget, you can optional "Always show", "Always hide" or "Auto hide" every single widget frame independently.
[*]Some basic widget options, such as "Always on top", "Transparent" options are integrated in the standard widget menu, so there're no extra codes needed for a 3rd-party widget to support such options.
[*]New widget options: "Opacity", "Show on desktop/launcher", "Mouse activation" and more.
[*]Anyone can code QML scripts to create widgets now.
[/list]

[h1]Data Picker[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/3079b3e61b0d854196dc9d195812c59b655eff17.png[/img]

[list]
[*]We remake a more friendly data selection and preview dialog. Also URL type data could be previewed as a image.
[*]"Update parameter" and "Invoke parameter" inputs are now featured with preference settings, no more geek codes.
[*]New "GPU Data": You don't have to install 3rd-party applications to read general GPU information now.
[*]New "WMI Data": Query based system information.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/d237b3439591b88e355a95e9c2c2f0eb0a1760d9.jpg[/img]

Let's introduce the new geek "Script Value" which allows writing JavaScript codes to satisfy some "hard-core" requirements:

[*]Customizing value format.
[*]Combining outputs from multiple values.
[*]Data sharing and persistence.
[*]Converting values to displaying images.
[/list]

[h1]Icon Picker[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/ab13e72b974e9bb3c3d73b954af63f8b1666c7bd.png[/img]

Icon catalogs are added to the new icon picker dialog, it also allow choosing a EXE file as a common icon.

[h1]Image Picker[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32138012/ba088dfec275d11e37a449eac8e0dbe84d627086.png[/img]

Image previewing is added to the new image picker dialog.

notes.title: Version Update 0.9.2
notes.content:
[h1]+ New Full-featured Workshop[/h1]

Aincrad Workshp has 5 main sections, you can browse, search, subscribe, download, manage and create workshop items easily.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/aa9eeba4da120111721481e4266c3e923b4018db.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/103e4a3374a54ee9884901526115a57c63d4242c.png[/img]
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/00242b34e6c9d2fc237eecca4a8f1c57046e8e24.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/b2919fa82778cd65504efdc4809cc8efcc0999ec.png[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/30e3a4cd410ceda6bf543385547f084a26c1d1f6.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/efee4d9f8196e37a86b3217fa3a5d643c593b8af.png[/img][/url]

[h1]+ New "Image Set" Workshop Item Type[/h1]

You could craft and subscribe this new "Image Set" items in the workshop, and make use of them via the image pick up dialog from:
[list]
    [*]Image Widget
    [*]GGO Widget
    [*]Information panel of launcher menus
[/list]
BMP, GIF, ICO, JPG, PNG formats are supported.

[h1]+ New Achievements[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/deb860c27eef11225b57ac8efce84f8157ea9a88.png[/img]

[h1]+ New option for touch gesture[/h1]

Turn on or off the "Two fingers sliding down" gesture for touch devices, you could find this switch via Preference - General - Enable Touch Gesture.

[h1]+ Add Spanish translation[/h1]

Many thanks to the translation work by [url=https://github.com/MoonAntonio]MoonAntonio[/url] .
You will find the translation sources for SAO Utils in our [url=https://github.com/NERvGear/locales/tree/Steam]Locale Repository[/url] 

[h1]+ Other Updates[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fix url file's icons are not displayed correctly in "Real Folder" launcher menu
    [*]Fix cannot run some programs via launcher menu
    [*]Fix some system cannot load [u]Web Browser Engine[/u] plug-in
    [*]Fix Steam keep "In App" status even if SAO Utils already exited
    [*]Fix Steam inject overlays into apps launched by SAO Utils
[/list]

notes.title: Version Update 0.9.1
notes.content:
[h1]+ Add Steam features switch option[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/ff5d688f922b82992f6731f1399d8282490cbe50.png[/img]
Disable it will
[list]
    [*]Remove associations to Steam, stop in-game time counting
    [*]Prevent killing SAO Utils when Steam exit
    [*]HP-Bar no more display Steam level
    [*]Unable to download or upload workshop items
[/list]

[h1]+ Add CN, EN, JA chat channels[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32138012/83b2f1889afd50dedac75241bb40393aaa0b11ed.png[/img]

[h1]+ Update Traditional Chinese translation[/h1]
Many thanks to the translation work by [url=http://www.zhtw.me/]zhtw[/url] .
You will find the translation sources for SAO Utils from our [url=https://github.com/NERvGear/locales/tree/Steam]Locale Repository[/url] .

[h1]+ Fix "Disable mouse gesture in fullscreen mode" does not work properly[/h1]
Someone claim that they can't use mouse gesture to call out the launcher after checking "Disable mouse gesture in fullscreen mode" option.
That's really a bug issued by NVIDIA GeForce Experience :P

Many thanks to the update work by TimeLord.
